property_summary: After calling freezeAccount on an address to freeze it, then calling burn on the owner, the reference contract sets frozenAccount[target] to true, while the buggy contract leaves it false — the concrete scenario uses address 0x123 as target, calls freezeAccount(0x123, true), then owner calls burn(100), and asserts that c.frozenAccount(0x123) is true (reference) vs false (bug).
change_summary: Replace frozenAccount[target] = freeze with frozenAccount[target] = false; to always set frozen to false on freeze.
